prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1067; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers were dispatched to a sideswipe collision in Katy, Texas, involving two vehicles. Driver 1 reported moving into the adjacent lane when the side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear passenger side of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy for the vehicle involved. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and stated that the impact jolted the body forward and back. Passenger was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived and remained at the scene. Damage to Driver 1's vehicle lines up with the contact described, with scraping and crushed panels along the rear quarter. Officers found no prior damage to either vehicle that would suggest an earlier incident. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the vehicle positions and some of the damage, though no independent witnesses came forward. Both drivers were cooperative and exchanged information. Officers issued no citations at the scene and documented the incident for insurance purposes.
